objective: Durable parent-to-child delegation contract over task_plan_versions, task_node_runs, AgentInstance/Session/Run, dependency edges, concurrency groups, plan revisions, leases and Phase 2 budgets. Spawn returns only durable handle; results via explicit durable events/artifacts/summaries.

delegation_contract.handle: DelegationHandle (child_agent_run_id, parent_agent_run_id, root_agent_run_id, delegation_depth, delegation_reason, allocated_budget, failure_policy)
delegation_contract.spawn_returns: durable child handle only; child result via explicit durable events/artifacts/summaries, never raw output
delegation_contract.depth_budget_authority: Phase 2 AgentBudgetController (clamp_limits, max_recursion_depth, max_child_agents, max_parallel_children); child cannot create new budget

bounded_context_enforcement.validation: DelegationContext.validate_bounded() + project_bounded_context() enforces 20-item caps and non-empty goal/subtask

failure_policy_semantics.replace: replace_child (mark failed, new child spawned separately)
failure_policy_semantics.fail_parent: fail_parent (transition parent loop to FAILED via AgentLoopLifecycle)

integration.orchestrator_seam: OrchestratorService._delegation_controller_impl() via DelegationRepositoryPort / AgentLoopRepositoryPort (no direct storage import)
integration.trajectory: delegation events (delegation_child_spawned/completed/failed/escalated) via MultiAgentRepository.append_event; bounded_context durably stored for compaction audit
integration.leases: delegation rows survive lease expiry/takeover; fencing at execution layer, delegation at orchestration layer
integration.compaction: ContextCompactor preserves delegation bounded_context; parent pause (PAUSED) does not block child publish

scenario_coverage.parent_research_a_b_script_critic: Parent spawns 4 children (Research A/B, Script, Critic) with distinct failure policies; verified via test_parent_spawns_four_children_with_bounded_context
scenario_coverage.restart: Delegations survive worker restart (new DelegationController instance sees same rows) via test_restart_visibility
scenario_coverage.parent_pause: Parent PAUSED (WAITING_CHILD->PAUSED) while children publish; then resume to RUNNING via test_parent_pause_child_continues
scenario_coverage.child_failure: Child failure with declared policies (retry/replace/partial/skip/escalate/fail_parent) via test_failure_policies_declared_and_applied and test_fail_parent_policy
scenario_coverage.lease_takeover: Delegation rows survive simulated lease expiry/takeover (new worker reclaims) via test_lease_takeover (durable delegation independent of fencing)
scenario_coverage.compaction: ContextCompactor preserves delegation bounded_context; delegation survives compaction via test_parent_pause_child_continues
